title: Who has better marketing? Quest or Barebells? 🫣
description: Who has better marketing? Quest or Barebells? 🫣
transcript: who has better marketing quest or barbells because both are massive protein brands but both are running surprisingly low ad volume for how big they are quest is pushing protein milkshakes chips bars and snacks their ads are simple it's high protein and low sugar and a craving replacements snack smarter they are sending traffic to collection pages which makes sense because quest has a huge product catalog but the problem is this they should be running way more creative angles like gym snack videos mom snacks late night cravings office snacks lunch box replacement weight loss macros high protein desserts Costco Discovery retail proof greater taste test because quest has the product range to run hundreds of angles but the ad volume just does not match the size of the brand barbells is playing a different game they're leaning harder into lifestyle cravings and TikTok Shop the ads feel more native it's protein soda candy style bars creator reactions taste test Swedish candy reimagine and it's your new obsession it feels less like nutrition marketing and more like snack culture and TikTok Shop is the big difference barbells is pushing hard with over 95,000 bars already sold with the official shop badge product card social proof creator content moving at scale quest does not appear to be leaning into TikTok Shop the same way that matters because protein bars are perfect for TikTok Shop it's an impulse buy low price point easy creator demo Easy taste test easy comparisons and easy repeat purchases both are leaving money on the table but both are using completely different strategies who do you think is winning let me know below
